desc: Implement the two-pointer greedy: i=0 (top pointer), j=N//2 (bottom pointer), count=0; while i < N//2 and j < N: if 2*A[i] <= A[j], pair them (count++, i++, j++); else j++
Write the main routine: read N and the array from stdin using fast I/O, run the algorithm, print the answer
Verify correctness against the provided samples mentally (sample 1 → 3, sample 2 → 0, sample 3 → 6) and confirm O(N) time complexity
